properties.name: A revising write says what it removed, and never silently shortens the record
properties.statement: Promoted 2026-09-20 on Anthony's word. flo2 measured thirteen full-field rewrites in one session; two silently dropped a load-bearing paragraph, both caught only by the author re-reading their own call. The reply already carries the prior value and compares nothing. THE OBLIGATION: a write that shortens a field says so in its reply, naming the field and the size of the loss. DELIBERATELY NOT a refusal: deleting on purpose is a legitimate edit, and a flag to permit it would cost a retry on every honest one. This is a report, not a gate.
